tasks.prompt: Fix B46 (Crazy Eights ends when one player can't draw) - designer accepted: crazy_eights.py _draw_one calls _resolve_blocked_game as soon as one player can't play and can't draw, and the NPC path then logs 'cannot draw' over the result. New rule: a player who can't play and can't draw passes; the game ends as blocked only when every player passes in a row (then the smallest hand wins, as the blocked rule already does). NPCs follow the same rule; the log must not overwrite the result. Test: with an empty draw pile, two players holding playable cards keep playing after a third player can't draw; when all pass in a row, the smallest hand wins.

Fix B47 (after drawing a playable card, any card can be played) - designer accepted: in crazy_eights.py, after a player draws, they may play only the drawn card (if it is playable) or pass. NPCs follow the same rule. Update the UI flow if it offers other cards after a draw (crazy_eights_ui.py / crazy_eights_screen.py), keeping the look otherwise unchanged. Test: after drawing a playable card, playing a different card from the hand is rejected; playing the drawn card or passing works; an NPC that draws only ever plays the drawn card.

Fix B48 (Score Four hint recursion can loop forever on an unsolvable puzzle): score_four.py's hint search recurses without a limit. Add a depth/work limit and a 'no hint' result the UI can show (keep current hints identical for solvable puzzles). Test: an unsolvable puzzle returns 'no hint' quickly (time-boxed); a known solvable puzzle returns the same hint as before.

D1 (part): delete the Score Four F6 debug hotkey from the Score Four table's event handler (solitaireplus/games/cards/score_four_screen.py loop_event_score_four). Test: pressing F6 on the Score Four table changes nothing.
